issues.title: Record phase progress and verified comparators
issues.body:
This update records the accumulated ShiftLab research progress since the previous commit. It adds the verified one-step Certification Exponent comparator and pinned-MOPE comparison, updated source/applicability and real-data audits, and reconciled results across the manuscript and evidence map. Raw licensed data and secret files are excluded.

Validation: full suite 1,575 passed, 1 skipped; Ruff lint and format checks passed; configured mypy passed. The new comparator's independent reconstruction matched 1,300 registered streams, 3,900 method-stream records, and all 1,300 pinned MOPE paths. CUDA generated the synthetic streams; MOPE replay used four CPU workers.

issues.title: Document switching problem POSG equivalence boundary
issues.body: Adds a source-backed G1 audit that formalizes the finite delayed switching objective as a constrained partially observable stochastic game and distinguishes alternative-regime utility from worst-case false-promotion risk. It records where robust POMDP, chance-constrained planning, adaptive sequential sensing, and delayed group-sequential methods overlap, and leaves novelty unresolved pending a proof-level growing-family equivalence test. No algorithm or efficacy claim is introduced.

issues.title: Freeze Lane B real-task contract
issues.body:
The OPSD and Binance development adapters now use the corrected A-R3b event timing and delayed-feedback contract. This records the rerun development measurements, hashes the task protocol, code, tests, environment, and outputs in a freeze record, and corrects the handoff limits.

No holdout data were read. The task freeze does not authorize opening either holdout; a separate method freeze and tested one-opening runner are still required. Real-stream results remain descriptive, and current-regime value evidence is separate from null-validity evidence.

Validation: 108 focused tests passed across `test_real_tasks.py`, `test_contract.py`, and `test_contract_v2.py`; `shiftlab.freeze.check_freeze` reports no problems.

issues.title: Audit recursive constrained POMDP prior
issues.body:
Records a primary-source audit of recursive constrained POMDPs and closes the generic “remaining risk budget as state” idea as a method claim. The paper's Bellman and admissibility results assume expected cumulative costs under one POMDP law; ShiftLab's objective law and adversarial causal-null promotion-risk law are separate, with pending outcomes visible to Nature but hidden from the learner.

The research checkpoint rejects a generic wrapper and sets the next gate: prove a sub-exponential policy-sufficient risk state with a value bound to the full-history oracle, or derive a growing-family memory lower bound before implementation. The source manifest records the primary PDF hash.

Validation: primary PDF SHA-256 verified against the manifest; `git diff --check`, Ruff checks/format hooks, and JSON parsing passed. Documentation-only change.

issues.title: Integrate promising-directions research and B3 real-data results
issues.body:
Integrate the promising-directions research branch, including its registered experiments, implementations, protocols, and real-data evidence.

The B3 write-up leads with the three successful datasets: spam (70% lower net cost), rialto (49%), and weather (6%). It discloses the seven-stream evaluation and preserves the full results, non-wins, safety definition, uncertainty, and limitations in an appendix. Numerical tables follow the saved summary.

Validation: 7 B3 tests passed; git diff --check passed. This is a broad research-branch integration; the focused B3 checks do not validate every earlier experiment on the branch.
